history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A high-angle, eye-level shot of four smartphones laid out on a wooden table, with a printed anime-style poster lying in front of them. The smartphones are arranged in a row, with the first on the left and the fourth on the right. Each phone displays a different app interface with a dark, tech-inspired aesthetic, featuring elements like anime characters, icons, and text.

The first phone on the far left shows an app with a blue and black theme, featuring a "Slam Dunk" anime logo and a character of Monkey D. Luffy. The second phone displays an app with a bright blue and white interface, showing a character that appears to be a variation of Sun Wukong. The third phone has a dark purple and black interface with an anime illustration of a female character with blue eyes. The fourth phone, on the far right, has a dark blue and teal interface, labeled "OTAX MENU BUG," with statistics like "Total Bugs," "Success Rate," and "Status." All phones have a minimalist, modern UI design.

In the background, a blurred bookshelf filled with books is visible, suggesting an indoor setting. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a slightly dramatic mood. The color palette is dominated by dark blues, purples, teals, and blacks, with pops of accent colors from the app interfaces and the anime poster. The overall mood is futuristic, tech-savvy, and subtly edgy, with a strong anime influence. The printed poster in the foreground features a detailed illustration of an anime character with white hair and a determined expression, set against a dark, futuristic background with glowing blue accents. Text on the poster lists "LIST PRODUK OTAX STORE" along with several service descriptions.
